entities.summary: Tullio Simoncini was an Italian physician known for alternative medicine advocacy. He is known for the claim that cancer is caused by the fungus Candida albicans, and has argued that cancer is a form of candida overgrowth. He also is known for claims that cancer can be cured with intravenous sodium bicarbonate. On his website, Simoncini says that he was formerly an oncologist. But that designation has been challenged by the medical community because of his use of sodium bicarbonate in the treatment of cancer.
